notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Cabal Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite black mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other instant and/or sorcery spell on the stack to get infinite copies of them.
